scheme_name: Bus Passes for the Construction Workers
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Must be a resident of the U.T. Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
Must be between 18 and 60 years of age
Must have engaged in building or other construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the U.T.
benefits_summary: 50% reimbursement of travelling cost for registered construction workers.
